panels.description: 查看 Pod  资源、镜像版本、运行状态和重启次数等指标

targets.expr: sum by (pod, container, image) (kube_pod_container_info{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$deployment-\\w+-\\w+", container!="gracefulshutdown"})
sum by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits_cpu_cores{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$deployment-\\w+-\\w+", container!="gracefulshutdown"})
sum by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits_memory_bytes{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$deployment-\\w+-\\w+", container!="gracefulshutdown"})
sum by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_running{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$deployment-\\w+-\\w+", container!="gracefulshutdown"})

sum by (pod, container) (time() - (container_start_time_seconds{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$deployment-\\w+-\\w+", container!="POD",container!="", container!="gracefulshutdown"}))
sum by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$deployment-\\w+-\\w+", container!="gracefulshutdown"})
sum by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests_cpu_cores{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$deployment-\\w+-\\w+", container!="gracefulshutdown"})
sum by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits_memory_bytes{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$deployment-\\w+-\\w+", container!="gracefulshutdown"})

panels.title: 资源总览

targets.expr: sum(irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="POD"}[$interval])) by (pod) / (sum(container_spec_cpu_quota{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="POD"}/100000) by (pod))

sum by (pod) (
  rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$interval])
)
/
sum by (pod) (
  rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$interval])
)

sum by (pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!~"POD|gracefulshutdown", container!="POD"}) / sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits_memory_bytes{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container!="", container!~"POD|gracefulshutdown"}) * 100
